svg.text: Mock-up (Claude): where "Start auto dev" would sit in the Discussion tab
1. An agreed summary whose Next step is "Send to the Worker"
[Summary, agreed]
Agreed
Next step
- Send to the Worker: "Implement auto dev: agent-room relays instructions …"
Start auto dev
Sends this instruction as cycle 1 of up to 5.
Auto-summarize is on for this run; your saved setting is unchanged.
(The button appears only on an agreed summary with "Send to the Worker", in a discussion, never in a brainstorm.)
2. While it runs: a status line above the message box
Auto dev running · cycle 2 of 5 · worker is working
(typing a message pauses it)
Worker report
the worker's full reply, as a normal message; the agents then discuss it
3. When it stops or pauses
Auto dev paused · reason: 5 cycles used (or: you sent a message / not agreed / WAIT FOR USER)
Next agreed instruction: "Fix the failing test in …"
Restart auto dev (5 more)
On FINISH: "Auto dev finished. Review and merge worker/main yourself."
Every relayed instruction also appears in the Worker tab as "Relayed from discussion", and everything is saved in the transcripts.
No separate "Send once" button in this version.
